title: Extended thinking interleaved with a tool loop

turns.prompt: Read every .txt file in the current directory, then reason out which of them could have been generated by the same rule and justify the grouping.
Re-check your grouping against the file you read last and say whether it still holds.

notes: Thinking plus tools is a distinct shape from either alone: the resent assistant turn carries a thinking block next to a tool_use block.
